title: MGI/Scodix/AccurioShine 能不能用普通冷烫膜？

seo.title: MGI/Scodix/AccurioShine 能不能用普通冷烫膜？

content:
## 内容定位

用于回答数字增效机、数字烫金机、MGI、Scodix、AccurioShine、JETvarnish、iFoil 等设备是否能使用普通冷烫膜的问题。

## Reddit 英文短评版

I would not treat MGI, Scodix or AccurioShine as normal cold foil systems.

They usually rely on UV polymer plus controlled heat, pressure and speed. A standard flexo cold foil may not release or bond correctly, even if the color looks similar. For these machines, I would test a digital foil grade separately.

## PrintPlanet 技术长评版

Digital embellishment systems such as MGI, Scodix and AccurioShine should be tested separately from traditional cold foil applications.

Traditional cold foil normally works with printed UV adhesive and inline curing. Digital foil systems often use UV polymer or raised varnish, followed by controlled heat and pressure to transfer the foil onto the polymer image.

Because of this, the foil requirements are different:

1. Release behavior under heated nip conditions

1. Compatibility with UV polymer surface

1. Clean edge definition on raised varnish

1. Stability at different speeds

1. Resistance to over-transfer and flying foil

A standard narrow-web cold foil may not be suitable. The correct approach is to test digital foil with a matrix of temperature, pressure, speed and polymer thickness.

## 知乎中文科普版

MGI、Scodix、AccurioShine这类数字增效设备，不能简单理解成普通冷烫机。

传统冷烫通常是“UV胶 + 冷烫膜 + UV固化”。而数字增效设备更多是“UV polymer / 数字光油 + 温度 + 压力 + 速度”共同完成金属膜转移。

所以普通柔印冷烫膜不一定能直接用在这类设备上。即使颜色看起来一样，离型层、受胶层、温度窗口和附着逻辑都可能不同。

如果要适配这类机器，应该单独测试digital foil，并记录温度、速度、压力、polymer厚度和图案类型。

## 阿里国际站成交版

For MGI, Scodix, AccurioShine and other digital embellishment systems, we recommend testing digital foil instead of standard flexo cold foil.

These systems usually require foil compatibility with UV polymer, controlled heated nip transfer, pressure and machine speed.

Please share your machine model, foil color, substrate and polymer/varnish type. We can provide digital foil samples for testing.

## 自然 CTA

We can provide digital foil samples for MGI, Scodix or AccurioShine testing based on your machine model and substrate.

## 关键词

digital foil MGI, Scodix foil, AccurioShine foil, JETvarnish iFoil, digital embellishment foil, 数字增效膜, 数字烫金膜
